visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young girl with long dark hair, wearing a white t-shirt and dark denim shorts, sits against a light-colored wood-paneled wall. She faces the camera with a lively expression, her mouth moving as she speaks. The indoor lighting is bright and even. (2) The scene cuts to a close-up of a white paper chart taped to the wall, featuring rows of green, red, and yellow dots. A hand enters from the side to point at specific dots while the girl continues to narrate. (3) Back to the girl, she gestures with her hands, showing a light blue smartwatch on her left wrist. She looks directly at the camera, her facial expressions shifting between serious explanation and cheerful smiles. (4) The camera zooms in on the girl's face as she discusses rules. She occasionally looks off-camera towards the interviewer. Graphical overlays with variety text appear periodically. (5) She holds her hands together in a pleading gesture, smiling broadly. An image of a mobile phone screen displaying a storybook app is overlaid on the frame. (6) The girl points her finger at the camera in a call-to-action gesture. A promotional graphic for a story app is held up in front of her. (7) The girl laughs and touches her cheeks, looking playful. Cartoon-style star and heart emojis are edited around her head to emphasize her joy. The background remains the wood wall throughout.

A 'pop' sound effect triggers during a visual transition. (3) As the girl explains the reward system, a melodic 'ding' sound effect highlights the mention of 'gold dots.' The BGM remains steady in the background. (4) The conversation continues with high pitch variability as they joke about gifts. (6) The video ends with a mix of the girl's laughter and a gentle fade-out of the acoustic guitar track, leaving a clean studio silence.
